## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Validation

- [ ] `ruff check src tests`
- [ ] `pytest -q`
- [ ] Hardware platform and Hailo/runtime versions recorded when applicable
- [ ] Failure modes and safety impact described
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] New media, models, datasets and copied code have compatible provenance/licensing

## Hardware and accessibility impact

Explain any changes to GPIO, power, motor behaviour, sensor thresholds, audio timing, speech commands or user-facing feedback.
